scene.bubble: Every good captain has a plan B. If it rains on Saturday, the picnic moves to the lighthouse!

activities.title: Match the if-half with the will-half.

pairs.right: you'll be cold on the boat

items.sentence: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
If you study, you ___ the test.
We'll cancel the match ___ the field is wet.
If she ___ her umbrella, she won't get wet.
___ I see Kili, I'll give him your message.

activities.title: Listen to the plan B meeting. Write a word in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Ingrid (con la pizarra de planes) y Kili (miembro del comité).
data.script: Ingrid: Saturday planning meeting! Plan A: picnic on the beach at twelve. … Ingrid: If it rains, plan B: we'll move everything to the lighthouse. … Ingrid: If the wind is too strong for the boat, we'll walk along the cliff path. … Ingrid: If Oliver forgets the sandwiches — again — Maya will bring emergency biscuits. … Ingrid: And if everything goes wrong… we'll still be together, and that's the real plan. … Ingrid: Kili agrees. Meeting closed! Team hands in… and wing!

Ingrid is reading the plan for the day. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the boy with red hair and a yellow shirt? … Maya: That is Oliver.
